newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE SLOW AT $64, OFF $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE SLOW AT $64, OFF $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, few sales $1.00 per cwt lower.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,900 slaughter steers and 2,200 heifers; 75,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 30,900 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 64.00.
Confirmed - 5,100 Last Week - None Year Ago - None
Wk to Date - 75,000 Last Week - 111,400 Year Ago - 113,700
